title: Medieval Tournament Place - fight for honor & glory
author: Das_Felixle

generated.description: A medieval jousting and tournament arena built with white wool tents, sandstone and stone brick walls, and spruce and oak wood trim, set on a large dirt and sand field. It is about 87 wide, 38 high and 172 deep, with a few small tent-like structures and a cauldron, chests, an enchanting table, and a furnace inside.
